# sprite-gen

Upstream: https://github.com/aldegad/sprite-gen
Version: 2.44.0; commit 3dc080aa8faa8b5a6dfe865b1247c047761f8fd1.
License: Apache-2.0 (LICENSE alongside this notice).
The wheel was built from that commit and is pinned by SHA256 in the worker requirements.
The upstream library is unmodified. Only the explicit OpenAI provider, prepare/extract/compose paths are used.
No facing vision, fallback provider, interpolation, curation server or automatic paid retries are enabled.
